qt: to the Commission Cynthia Ní Mhurchú (Renew) Subject:

Does the Commission intend to integrate the existing unique business identifiers used in EU transparency systems into procurement award and expenditure analytics, with a view to enabling a consolidated EU-wide overview of suppliers, their cumulative exposure to public contracts, and their strategic importance within the internal market?
at: (English version) to the Commission Cynthia Ní Mhurchú (Renew) (13 February 2026) Subject: Strengthening transparency and performance in EU public procurement and expenditure reporting Does the Commission intend to integrate the existing unique business identifiers used in EU transparency systems into procurement award and expenditure analytics, with a view to enabling a consolidated EU-wide overview of suppliers, their cumulative exposure to public contracts, and their strategic importance within the internal market? (14 April 2026) With an update to the current eForms notices published on Tenders Electronic Daily portal (1), the Commission intends to require buyers to provide not only the business identifier but also the type of identifier, such as a value added tax number or national identifier. This change will help create a more consolidated view of suppliers participating in EU-wide procedures.
